How the programme works
  • Based on net qualifying spend over the last 12 months, Bangkok time.
  • Settled orders count, net of refunds. Each order counts once, so a deposit and the final payment are never counted twice.
  • Unverified external vouchers don’t count. GoWabi purchases count only after the clinic has verified and approved them.
  • Reviewed monthly. If a tier would go down, you get 30 days’ notice, and benefits already earned keep their own terms.
